referenceRunner.label: ubuntu-24.04
referenceRunner.rationale: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu is accepted for candidate collection and measured noise, but CPU assignment and image identity are not stable enough to bind release budgets across runs.

blockers: Provision a stable named runner or record an explicit reviewed decision to accept one exact GitHub-hosted runner fingerprint for binding evaluation.
Record five or more samples for every statistical metric and review product targets before writing any ratification.
Extend authenticated baseline provenance to the golden-journey install, docs snapshot, and full-catalog reports before those cross-report metrics can bind.
